record.name: Clova: Wellness AI
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Clova Health's AI-based metabolic wellness coaching platform is designed to support weight loss and the management of prediabetes and diabetes.  The coaching platform integrates real-time continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) devices and various wellness monitoring tools including Apple Health to provide comprehensive personalized insights into your wellness & health.  With tracking your weight, exercise, sleep, and other wellness parameters & profile, the platform helps you to achieve your wellness goals.

Features:
* Signup/Sign-in: Sign up or sign in using your mobile number to receive mobile verification and join us.
* Onboarding: Complete a simple onboarding process, providing contact information, body parameters (weight and height), and stating your goal for weight control or glucose control.
* Track calorie and nutrient input: Track your daily meal portions for the count of calories and nutrients.  Glycemic index is ready for your search for alternative food with a low glucose index.  Additionally, schedule meals for improved glucose control, weight management, or both.
* Track calories burned by exercise.  Select the type and duration of your activity, and track the calories burned. You can schedule exercise sessions daily or weekly.  With integration to Apple Health, your exercise will be automatically uploaded for easy review.
* With AI analytics data from CGM, glucose health profiles of each meal for breakfast lunch and dinner can be compared side by side for optimal choice.   
* Sleep Condition Recording and Scheduling: Record your daily sleep condition as good, normal, or not good, and set reminders to prioritize quality sleep.
* Medications Recording and Scheduling: Log your medications and set reminders to take them on time.
* Record Stress Level: Keep track of your stress level by selecting options such as normal, slightly stressed, or stressed.
* Record Body Weight, Blood Pressure, and Pulse.
* Device Connectivity: Connect your Freestyle Libre device, a real-time continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) device, to aid in weight loss and glucose control.
* Insights: Receive notifications and insights related to glucose control and weight management.
* Book an Appointment: Schedule appointments on the calendar for coaching sessions.
* Ask Your Questions: Submit your questions to our staff via messaging.

Download the Clova App now to easily track and manage your health and wellness goals. Remember to consult a healthcare professional for accurate medical advice.


Disclaimer: Please note that the recommendations provided by this app are for informational purposes only and should not substitute professional medical advice. Before making any medical decisions, we strongly recommend consulting a healthcare professional.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Science-based mental health app for stress, journaling, habit building, and emotional clarity.

Meet Flourish, a science-based, award-winning mental health and well-being app designed by psychologists, ready to help you manage stress, overcome everyday emotional challenges, and support personal growth. Whether you’re feeling stuck, unmotivated, overwhelmed, anxious, or simply need a calm space to think things through, Flourish helps you regain clarity, calm, and motivation — often in just a few minutes.

Who is Sunnie?

Sunnie is your AI-powered mental health companion, habit coach, and accountability buddy. Trained by psychologists, Sunnie listens, asks thoughtful questions, and offers science-based insights and coping tools to help you reflect, manage emotions, take meaningful actions, and build lasting habits. With long-term memory, Sunnie gets to know you better over time and can surface helpful insights and patterns. Sunnie communicates naturally through text, voice, and images for a more engaging, supportive experience.

Features

Guided Journaling & Reflection for Mental Health
Get thoughts out of your head and onto the page. Our iconic Memory Jar helps you build emotional awareness, gain clarity, and feel lighter — in just a few minutes.

Stress & Anxiety Relief Tools
From breathing exercises to meditation, discover interactive activities designed to calm your mind, ground your body, and help you reset — anytime, anywhere.

Healthy Habit Building for Well-Being
Create small, realistic habits for well-being, social connection, and motivation. Sunnie helps you stay accountable and cheers you on along the way.

Mental Clarity & Focus Support
Feeling overwhelmed or procrastinating? Use brain dumps, task breakdowns, Pomodoro timers, and gentle nudges to turn mental chaos into clear next steps.

Community & Connection
Meet one of the warmest, most supportive online communities. With Flourish buddies and the Flourish community, you can share well-being activities, inspire each other, and move through life’s ups and downs together.

Science-Based & Trusted

Flourish is built by PhD psychologists and grounded in affective science, motivation science, and behavior change research. It is one of the highest-rated AI mental health and well-being apps, validated through scientific studies led by researchers from top universities (including Stanford and Harvard), shown to improve positive emotions, resilience, and stress levels.

Built with your privacy in mind

- Messages are protected with end-to-end encryption
- You can delete any chats at any time
- Optional biometric lock adds an extra layer of protection
- Designed for private, secure mental health support you can trust

What people say

“Flourish reminded me how to care for myself again.”
“Even on bad days, Flourish helps me see the good.”
“This app gives me peace of mind when I need it most.”
“I’ve tried so many wellness apps. This one actually stuck.”
“It gives me space to feel what I’m feeling without judgment.”
“I didn’t think anything could help with my procrastination — this did.”
“I use it when I’m spiraling. It really helps.”
“It’s like therapy, but on my own terms.”
“Sunnie has become part of my daily routine.”

Who Flourish is for

- Anyone seeking mental health support for stress or anxiety
- Students and professionals juggling busy lives
- People who journal — or want to start
- Those seeking gentle support between therapy sessions
- Anyone who wants to feel a little better, one small step at a time

Start your journey toward a happier, calmer life with Flourish — a science-based mental health app you can trust

record.name: Get Well Soon: AI Health Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Keep track of what you eat, how you feel and the questions you want to ask. Get Well Soon brings a meal and symptom diary, supportive AI coaching and condition information together in one place.

Log meals and symptoms as separate entries, with ingredients, notes and optional details. Look back through your diary when you want to remember what happened and when. As you add entries, the tracker can highlight possible patterns worth exploring. These are observations, not proof that a food caused a symptom or a reason to cut it out of your diet.

Talk things through with the AI Coach. Ask general health questions, discuss something you have read in a condition guide, or get support with an everyday wellbeing goal. Start a fresh conversation or return to a saved chat on the same device.

Coach Memory lets you save the goals and preferences you want the coach to remember, such as how you would like it to respond. It is optional, and you can review, change or delete what you have saved.

The condition library is still here too. Browse information about conditions, including food and diet topics, and open a related conversation with the coach when you have questions.

You choose what to share. Coach Memory and tracker sharing are off by default. If you link the tracker, the coach receives calculated summaries of possible patterns, not your individual diary entries or notes. Anything you type or paste into a chat is sent for processing, along with relevant recent messages and the optional context you have enabled. AI messages are processed through our server using Google Gemini.

Chats and tracker records are saved on your device. Settings includes controls to delete conversations, withdraw AI consent and delete your AI account. Account deletion leaves local tracker records in place; you can erase those separately in Tracker. Deleting your account does not cancel an Apple subscription.

Free AI Coach access includes up to 5 messages a day. Optional monthly and yearly subscriptions each include up to 30 messages a day. Both plans have the same daily allowance, which resets at midnight UTC. Messaging is not unlimited, and allowances may be temporarily reduced to protect service availability. Prices and billing periods are shown before you subscribe.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. Manage or cancel them in your Apple account settings. Restore Purchases is available on the subscription screen.

Get Well Soon is for adults aged 18 and over. It provides general information and wellbeing support, not diagnosis, treatment or emergency care. AI answers can be wrong. Check with a qualified healthcare professional before making medical or significant dietary changes, and do not stop prescribed treatment based on the app. For an emergency, contact your local emergency services.

record.description_evidence:
Meet Mochi - your stress, with a face.

Mochi is a stress companion for iPhone and Apple Watch. Instead of showing you a number and leaving you to interpret it, Mochi shows you himself: a small character whose color, mood, and surroundings reflect what your body is actually doing right now.

Powered by HRV (heart rate variability) and resting heart rate from Apple Health, Mochi turns physiological data into something you can feel at a glance — and gently nudges you toward the small daily habits that actually lower stress over time.

How Mochi reflects your day
- Calm — matcha green, sipping tea in morning light
- Balanced — sakura pink, holding a cherry blossom under a bright sky
- Tense — warm amber at golden hour, holding a mandarin
- Strained — lavender at twilight, wrapped in a small bundle
- Overload — deep blue at night, lit by a small warm lamp

Same Mochi, same scene — five emotional states, five times of day. A full arc from morning calm to evening exhaustion, lived through one character.

What's inside
- Today — Mochi's current state, your HRV and RHR, a short breath ritual
- Habits — sleep regularity, movement, mindfulness, daylight
- History — your stress timeline by hour, day, and week
- Body — HRV baseline, resting heart rate, VO2, biological age
- Settings — watch widgets, subscription, profile

Built on your own baseline
Mochi compares your HRV to your own 7-day baseline, not to population averages. "Above your usual" means more than a generic "good." Your body, your numbers.

Privacy first
No account. No cloud. No tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Requirements

record.description_evidence:
Track your vital wellness metrics in seconds using optical camera scanning and intelligent AI analysis.

Pulselio transforms your daily routine by providing non-invasive, real-time insights into your body’s signals—helping you build healthy lifestyle habits with smart continuous monitoring.

OPTICAL SCANNING & INSTANT VITALS
Simply look into your front camera. Powered by advanced optical rPPG algorithms, Pulselio extracts micro-vascular blood flow signals to deliver accurate daily estimates:
• Heart Rate (BPM)
• Respiration Rate (BrPM)
• Heart Rate Variability (HRV)
• Stress Level Index
• Heart Effort (dB)
• Visual Skin Age Estimation

SMART BODY COMPOSITION & TRENDS
Log and track essential body composition metrics to monitor overall vitality over time:
• Body Mass Index (BMI)
• A Body Shape Index (BSI)
• Waist-to-Height Ratio (WtHR)
• Multi-day visual trend graphs to spot wellness patterns

AI-POWERED WELLNESS SUMMARIES
Receive personalized lifestyle summaries and wellness guidance generated by smart AI analysis (powered by Google Gemini API). Understand how daily rest, exercise, and recovery impact your vitality.

PRIVACY-FIRST DESIGN
Your privacy is our utmost priority. Camera video feeds are processed ephemerally in real-time memory. We do NOT save, store, or upload your facial photos, videos, or biometric templates.

IMPORTANT MEDICAL DISCLAIMER:
Pulselio: AI Health Trackr is designed strictly for general fitness and wellness reference. It is NOT a medical device and is not intended for medical diagnosis, treatment, prevention, or clinical management of any condition.

Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for medical advice.

Unlimitr (formerly Health Click Away) makes wellness simple, personal, and enjoyable.

record.description_evidence:
HealthyMe transforms your Apple Health data into meaningful insights using on-device AI. Instead of staring at raw numbers, get personalized summaries that explain what your health trends actually mean.

INTELLIGENT TREND ANALYSIS
See how your metrics are changing over time with daily, weekly, and monthly comparisons. HealthyMe identifies patterns and tells you whether you're improving, declining, or staying consistent—with clear explanations of why it matters.

FIVE COMPREHENSIVE HEALTH CATEGORIES

• Heart — Track resting heart rate, walking heart rate, HRV, and more. Understand your cardiovascular health at a glance.

• Performance — Monitor steps, distance, active calories, VO2 Max, and exercise minutes. Know if your fitness is trending up.

• Sleep — Analyze total sleep, stage breakdown (REM, Core, Deep), efficiency, and awakenings. Get insights into your rest quality.

• Vitality — Follow weight, BMI, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, and wrist temperature trends over time.

• Mindfulness — Track meditation sessions, total mindful minutes, and consistency patterns.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
All AI processing happens entirely on your device using Apple Intelligence. Your health data never leaves your iPhone. No accounts, no cloud uploads, no tracking.

ALWAYS READY
Cached data loads instantly so you never wait for a loading screen. Background updates keep everything fresh without interrupting your experience.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
HealthyMe is designed for informational and educational purposes only and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or health condition. The insights provided by this app should not be considered medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making any health-related decisions or changes to your lifestyle, diet, or exercise routine. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, call your local emergency services immediately.

record.name: Holistic Wellness AI
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Bring your everyday wellness into one place. Holistic Wellness AI combines meal planning, nutrition logging, workouts, mindfulness and support from wellness professionals in a connected daily experience.

PLAN YOUR DAY WITH AURA
Explore meal, fitness and mindfulness ideas based on your goals and preferences. Ask Aura for guidance, review the suggestions and make the plan your own.

MEALS AND NUTRITION
Explore recipes, plan meals and keep a food diary. Use meal-photo analysis to estimate calories and macros, then review and edit the estimates before saving. Follow step-by-step cooking guidance with timers and voice controls where supported.

WORKOUTS YOU CAN MAKE YOUR OWN
Build a personal workout or start one assigned by your coach. Review exercise instructions, edit sets, reps and weight, and log each exercise individually. Quick increment and decrement controls make adjustments easier, with kilograms and pounds supported.

See all exercise sets together, with editable reps and weight, quick adjustment controls and a Log button that stays visible. Confirm a set to move to the next, with automatic focus and scrolling.

Track work and rest with the workout timer. Fully logged coach workouts save automatically. Save partial progress if you finish early, or cancel an unsaved session if you did not do the workout. Undo a coach workout completed today to remove its logged exercise results and reopen the assignment.

MINDFULNESS AND DAILY HABITS
Explore guided mindfulness and breathing sessions. Keep your planned activities together on Today, track your progress and build a routine that fits your schedule.

CONNECTED COACHING
When you work with a wellness professional, see assigned tasks on Today and share the workout results you choose to record. Professionals can review shared assigned and personal workout history, including the actual reps and weight logged for individual sets.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICES
Choose which activity information to share with your professional. Optional connected-health features, including Apple Health on compatible devices, require your permission.

Holistic Wellness AI supports general wellness and healthy routines. AI-generated suggestions and nutrition estimates can be reviewed and edited. The app does not provide medical diagnosis or replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional.

record.description_evidence:
With hundreds of mindfulness meditation apps to pick from, what makes Meditopia so special? Well, unlike most of the other options, Meditopia offers more than just a short-term solution to falling asleep, finding balance and de-stressing; we offer each member over 1000 deep-dive meditations and breathing exercises that get right to the heart of what we as a people, regardless of age, background, or experience, are dealing with everyday.

These meditations, offered in 12 languages, aim to cover the entire spectrum of human experiences from relationships, expectations, acceptance, and loneliness, to our body-image, sexuality, life purpose, and feelings of inadequacy. Meditopia doesn’t just want to be a band-aid for wounds which we know require permanent healing. Our goal is to create a mental health sanctuary in which you can access the guidance and tools you need to build up mental resilience, calm, balance, a healthy headspace and peace of mind. Everything you need to feel happier, relax, and sleep like a baby.

Download now and try a free meditation! 

What can you get with Meditopia?

Sleep Meditations + Breathing exercises
Your quality of sleep affects almost every aspect of your daily life. So why not help yourself get better sleep? Try any one of our +30 sleep meditations to learn new techniques as well as breathing and visualization exercises that you can continue to practice throughout the rest of your life to promote good sleep. Say bye to that old sound machine and that one-function breathing app.

Bedtime Stories 
Bedtime fairy stories aren’t just for kids! As you tuck yourself into bed, all warm and cozy, let us lull you to sleep with our wide selection of bedtime stories. From fairy tales and adventures to experiences in places all throughout the world, feel yourself getting pulled into these vivid and soothing stories. After all, at the end of a long day, you deserve to gently ease into a dreamworld of sleep and recovery. We also have a wide library of sleep sounds like rain, waves, and relaxing noises like white noise and more.

AI Therapy
Introducing SOUL, our custom AI therapy solution. Designed by psychologists and mental health experts, SOUL is your AI mental health companion. Tailored to address diverse mental health needs, SOUL utilizes its intricate understanding of language nuances to offer personalized support, engaging users in insightful and compassionate dialogue

Apple Watch + Siri Shortcuts
Even if you don't have your iPhone with you, you can access all of our content from Apple Watch!

Our Top Features:
+1000 guided meditations
Nature sounds with a timer
Independent WatchOS app
Apple HealthKit integration to count your worry-free minutes
Dark Mode support
Daily Meditations on a new topic every day
Daily Inspirational Quotes
Personal Note-taking to track your progress
Mindful Meter to see your mindfulness stats at a glance
In-app challenges with friends to feel challenged
Custom reminders to sleep and meditate
Siri shortcuts
User-friendly and user-oriented interface

record.description_evidence:
MUUD AI — your AI wellness coach.

Meet MUUD AI: a conversational coach that helps you understand how you feel, decide what to do next, and stay connected to the people who matter.

YOUR MUUD AI COACH
Chat with MUUD AI anytime. It listens, picks up on how you're feeling, remembers what matters to you, and turns it into clear next steps — with one-tap suggestions that take you straight to the right place in the app. Prefer to talk? Use your voice.

YOUR DAILY AI BRIEFING
Start each day with a personalized MUUD AI briefing that pulls your recent check-ins and progress into one focused read.

AI ICE-BREAKERS
Stuck on what to say? MUUD AI drafts conversation starters to help you reach out — one-on-one, in groups, or with new people.

CHECK IN & SEE YOUR JOURNEY
Quick mood and wellness check-ins become Moments. Journal with guided prompts and watch patterns form into your Journey over time.

CONNECT — ON YOUR TERMS
Circles let you choose who you share with. Connection is opt-in, always.

YOUR DATA, IN THE MUUD VAULT
Everything lives in the MUUD Vault — a private, consent-governed record you control. Encryption and consent gating are defaults.

DESIGNED FOR MUUD RING
MUUD AI works with MUUD Ring (sold separately), a biometric wearable that brings signal from your day into your Journey.

—

MUUD AI supports personal wellness and self-reflection. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or emergency services. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 (US) or dial 911.

Founded by Dr. Armin Hoes, MD.
